This petition coming on for admission this day, th e cou
 following:
 Order

Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that petition is filed against the award dated 23.02.2016 passed by the Office of Sub Divisional Officer and Land Acquisition Officer, Itarsi in Revenue Case No.3/v-82/2014-15.

Shri Chandra Mohan Tiwari takes an objection that in terms of the provisions contained in Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, petitioners have an alternative statutory remedy of making a reference to the authority and since petitioners have not availed this remedy, petition is not maintainable.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that Hon'ble Coordinate Bench of this Court has decided W.P. No.1624/2023 vide order dated 03.08.2023 and has disposed of the petition placing reliance on the decision of Geeta Dey Vs. Union of India and Others decided on 10.07.2023 in W.P.
No.3469/2023.
After pursuing the impugned award, it is evident that Section 64 of the Act of 2013 includes disputes in relation to the rights of Rehabilitation and Resettlement under Chapters V and VI.

entities.text: Geeta Dey Vs. Union of India and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Chapters V and VI deals with the provision for Rehabilitation and Resettlement award and procedure and manner of Rehabilitation and Resettlement and in view of such facts, relief of grant of appointment in lieu of the land so acquired will fall within the terms of the Chapters V and VI of the Act of 2013,
therefore, petitioners have a remedy to approach the concerned Authority as provided under Section 64, therefore, this potion cannot be adjudicated on its own merits in view of availability of alternative statutory remedy.

It is directed that in case petitioners file an application under Section 64 to the concerned Collector then, concerned Collector shall consider the application and if it is not otherwise barred shall make a reference to the authorities so designated in this behalf for hearing and deciding the application of the petitioners on its own merits.
In above terms, this petition is disposed of.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE Tabish Smt. Neena vs Union Of India on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132704030/
